column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way I Wouldn't Help My Little Sister
Good day, err, is everyone doing well?
Ah, Kiririn-san, it has been a while! I was worried since you haven't logged on for quite some time.
You usually come online to chat with us almost daily.
Sorry, I was a little busy with work.
Heh, I thought you had surely returned to your homeland, the planet of fashion mongers.
...What's with the sudden impoliteness from this person?
Well, to put it in a way you can understand, she's saying "I was lonely. You could have at least contacted me."
Huh? How can you even interpret that annoying sentence that way?
There's no way such a perverse person exists.
The one before my eyes is also such a person.
Putting that aside, talk about the Kyoto souvenirs first, all right?
...Tch, I know that.
Err, the guy with eyes of a dead fish made me tell you guys that he would like to hand over souvenirs he got from Kyoto to you.
D-Dead fish...?
Oh my, big brother Kyousuke wants to give us something? What kind of souvenirs are they?
If we were to consider Senpai's tastes, it's better for us not to have high expectations of the souvenirs.
...No one is supporting me.
What are you mumbling about? So, what should I say next?
Guh...
Err, n-next...
How about talking about the recent game tournament?
Well, just following the flow of the conversation naturally will suffice, I guess.
Huh? So that's okay? Then...
The two of them are good girls inside, so whatever Kirino types, they'll follow through somehow.
I'll just relax and watch over the chat between Kirino and the other two...
Err... He's been talking about nothing but games and anime for a while now and is being seriously annoying, you know? Send.
...Wait, what the heck are you writing?!
There's a limit up to not being able to read the atmosphere!!
Ki-Kiririn-san, did something happen today? You seem to be acting different from usual...
Yes, usually you're 16 times more unpleasant.
I hope your black-stained soul falls into the depths of purgatory.
Huh? I don't get what you're saying at all.
Right back at you. You were joyfully talking about that game and anime just the other day.
No, usually, the topics discussed by girls our age are about make-up or fashion, right? You guys are the strange ones...
I told you to stop. There's no need for you to say that much.
To solve this kind of misunderstanding, you have to tell the other person straight up.
You just calmly typed something that would make your usual self flip out angrily if you read it.
Aaah, those girls are probably looking open-mouthed at the screen of their computers right now.
Damn it, I'll have to do something about that later...
Kirino, talk about the prizes we won from the game tournament the other day.
Huh? I don't know anything about that. Talking about it normally is impossible.
It doesn't matter what you say. You can ask what everyone is doing with their prizes, for example. Anyway, just bring up the topic.
After all, the other party includes the really considerate Saori.
Even if a topic is forcibly brought up, she'll definitely make sure that the conversation develops pleasantly.
...I get it.
Come to think of it, about the prizes we won from the game tournament the other day. What did everyone do with theirs?
I waterproofed my Tentacle Little Sister poster and made it into a bath curtain. I can spend my bath time happily thanks to that.
Hey... what are these people saying? Rather, what does she mean by tentacles?
...It's best that you don't think about it too deeply.
By the way, Tentacle Little Sister is the nickname of the character, Madouin Reika, that appears in Siscaly, but...
Putting the Tentacle Little Sister in the bathroom... why did she make such a choice?
If I remember correctly, Kiririn-san's portion was the autograph board signed by a seiyuu.
You even said you would send us a photo of it being displayed in your room, but what happened afterwards?
Eh...
C-Crap!
Hold on, what's going on?
I-It's this autograph board. Quickly take a photo of it with your cell phone and send it to them.
W-What's this... Not only do I have no idea whose autograph that is, the illustration on it reeks of otaku.
Rather, this is my limit. Why do I have to join in on this 100% otaku filled conversation?
C-Calm down, these people have no ill intentions.
Shut up. Even if there aren't any ill intentions, what makes me angry just makes me angry.
Aaah, geez! We can talk about that later! For now, say that you'll send it to them later and properly deceive them.
This is bad. Kirino can't keep up with the otaku conversation with these two, and her anger is reaching its limit.
Although I was hoping that some shock therapy would work, based on how things are looking right now, it's no good...
Sorry, I forgot about it. I'll send the photo over another time.
No, please don't worry about it.
Ufufu, speaking of photos, we took a photo of the three of us during one of the many times we got together at an offline meeting.
P-Photo? Was there such a thing?
Oh my? I didn't send it to Kiririn-san? Sorry, it must have carelessly slipped my mind.
Then, I'll send it to you now.
What's... this.... it's me?
Yes, the one in the Gothic Lolita outfit is Kuroneko, and the big one with swirly glasses is Saori.
But... I don't remember taking this photo before.
...You look really happy in this photo.
...You understand, right? These people really are your friends.
... How... is that...
Hey, Kirino, where are you going?
I know, try talking about the Siscaly Game tournament next.
Huh?! I don't know anything about that!
Even if you don't know about it, you certainly participated. So your body must remember it. You'll remember as you speak about it.
Tsk, you read way too much manga.
Err... By the way, about the Siscaly tournament...
That really was a pity.
Your brother's incompetence surpassed my expectations by far.
What does arcade version mean?
Heh, did your clan forget even that? As expected of an active writer in middle school, the Magic Circuits in your brain are lacking.
...Also, since earlier, you've been repeatedly asking about nothing except things you should already know about.
This girl... I really want to kill her...
W-Well, endure it. She suffers from an incurable illness, so she sometimes says strange things.
The incurable illness known as being a Chuunibyou.
....But seriously, Kuroneko is as sharp as always.
Tch...
H-Hey, where do you think you're going?
...Even if you can fool commoners, you can't fool me, the mistress favored by darkness.
【Something's strange】 about you today.
Yeah, to be honest I'm wondering about that too.
Just what are you hiding exactly?
This is bad... her loss of memory is going to be exposed at this rate.
Guh... that Kirino, where did she go at a time like this?
What should I do, what should I do...?
S-Since it's come to this, I can only try to fool them.
T-There's nothing wrong at all!
...Is that the case? Well, we will stop asking if it's difficult to speak about it.
A-As expected from Saori...
She's a woman that can splendidly read the atmosphere despite her outward appearance.
You're saying I'm weird... Do I seem that way?
Yes, it's obvious you're acting strange.
As I thought, something happened during our last chat?
...Well, I can't really remember it well... what happened exactly?
Hmm, if you can't remember, I can tell you about it, but...
With words that conveyed a sense of puzzlement, Saori started explaining about what happened during their last chat, on the 14th of July.
Rather, how could he have gone on a school trip without playing 【Sis×Sis】!
Well well, just as you have your own school life, Kiririn-san, I think big brother Kyousuke has his own life too.
Hmph. To begin with, the reason you're angry isn't actually because he didn't play the game, right?
W-What are you saying?!
You're that upset because your beloved brother has been taken away by Belphegor? Your kung fu was not enough.
Huh? I'm fine even without him here.
Well... It is better to have him here than not. Just a little.
Well, I have Rinko-rin from 【Sis×Sis】 with me.
...A siscon to the extreme, huh. That perverted little sister fetish of yours is beyond help.
You too will completely understand the wonderfulness of a little sister if you listen to that godly dialogue in Rinko-rin's route!
...【I've always, always loved you】, right?
Yes, yes, yes. It leaves such strong impression!
...I just saw your end. Losing sight of the boundaries between 2D and 3D, you'll meet a miserable end while writhing in despair.
Aaaahyouqawsedrftgyhujikol.
And after that, Kiririn-san didn't reply back anymore for a while.
There weren't any other entries after that... I was really worried.
...Could it be that something happened after that, Kiririn-san?
I've finished absorbing the knowledge from that encyclopedia into my inner world. I no longer have any interest in that item whose form can only be
called a book.
Well well, big brother Kyousuke had almost no experience with the arcade version, so it's unreasonable to wish for him to be better than that
in the short time he had.
